## Goal

The durable outcome in one sentence.

## Done when

Observable acceptance conditions.

## Current

Present facts that affect dispatch. Name claims, dependencies, or gates only
when they matter now.

## Next

Immediate authorized action(s), awaited bound transition, or needed human
decision.

## Needs from human

None

## Boundaries

Only non-obvious current constraints or recovery limits; use None when
canonical project rules suffice.

## Evidence

Links or exact identities for accepted evidence; no action history or duplicate
attestations.
